initial_state: Empty independent bank for each method/family. Same arriving source contents; each method creates its own views and actual feedback.
reader: Original normal Host Reader via existing Qwen JSON action transport
checkpoint_rule: Load exactly the saved final96 checkpoint, never the old open-only selector. Wait for training terminal success before any rollout.
failure_policy: First responses retained; known-usage length failure counted and next distinct input continues. Other errors inspected, no automatic same-position retry.
interpretation: Development sample, not holdout. Prefix preference matching, actual task success, state correctness and costs reported separately.
checkpoint_reload: Training saves FP16 then runtime loads its normal checkpoint representation; pre-save diagnostic is not interchangeable with own-policy evaluation.
